title: RegioZH: Unveiling Comprehension Disparities across Regional Chinese Varieties in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.31262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current evaluations often treat Chinese varieties as monolithic, obscuring failures for regional users. We introduce RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia. Built by region-specific annotators and expert-validated, it targets localized idioms, slang, code-mixing, politeness conventions, and sociocultural expressions. Zero-shot results on eleven LLMs show large disparities, including a 29.4-point average accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore. Persona and structured chain-of-thought prompts for five models yield selective gains, suggesting that some errors stem from retrieval or framing rather than only missing knowledge. translated_title: RegioZH：揭示大语言模型对不同地区中文变体理解能力的差异
translated_abstract: 当前的评估往往将中文变体视为单一整体，掩盖了模型对地区用户的理解失败。我们提出了 RegioZH，这是一个包含 2,607 道多项选择题的基准，用于评估覆盖中国大陆、台湾、香港、新加坡和马来西亚的地区性词汇推理能力。该基准由各地区专门的标注者构建并经专家验证，聚焦于本地化习语、俚语、语码混合、礼貌规范以及社会文化表达。在十一个大语言模型上的零样本测试结果显示出巨大差异，其中包括台湾与新加坡之间平均 29.4 个百分点的准确率差距。对五个模型使用角色设定和结构化思维链提示仅带来选择性的提升，表明部分错误源于检索或表述框架问题，而不仅仅是知识缺失。表征、注意力、校准和表面特征分析显示，标记注意力与语义基础之间存在分离、强制选择题中存在过度自信的错误，且本地化词汇密度是……
tldr: 该论文提出 RegioZH——首个覆盖中国大陆、台湾、香港、新加坡和马来西亚的 2,607 题地区中文词汇推理基准，揭示了大语言模型在理解不同地区中文变体上的显著差异（如台湾与新加坡之间 29.4 个百分点的准确率差距），并表明部分错误源于检索或表述框架问题而非单纯的知识缺失。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional Chinese lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia, revealing large comprehension disparities across eleven LLMs (including a 29.4-point accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore) and showing that some errors stem from retrieval or framing issues rather than missing knowledge.
